fusions.name: Ponderous Shove
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Lob
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full 6-tile reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Bulk
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds, and up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Land
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
